title: DiffuSearch: How Hybrid Trajectory Planning Benefits from Aligned Objectives in Diffusion and Action Space
abstract: arXiv:2609.02252v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In trajectory planning for autonomous driving, hybrid planning architectures are often realized as a collection of disparate modules, each with its own objectives. This lack of a unifying principle can lead to inconsistencies between the initial and refined trajectory, resulting in suboptimal behavior. We address this by introducing DiffuSearch, a novel hybrid planner that uses a unified set of objectives across generation and refinement. Our model encourages all components to follow the same shared driving goals: collision avoidance, drivable area compliance, comfort, and progress. DiffuSearch employs a two-stage architecture. First, a guided diffusion model generates a scene-consistent, joint trajectory prediction, using our driving objectives as differentiable guidance functions to implicitly steer the denoising process. translated_title: DiffuSearch：混合轨迹规划如何从扩散空间与动作空间的目标对齐中获益
translated_abstract: 在自动驾驶的轨迹规划中，混合规划架构通常被实现为一系列各自拥有独立目标的模块集合。这种缺乏统一原则的做法可能导致初始轨迹与精化轨迹之间的不一致，从而产生次优的驾驶行为。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 DiffuSearch，一种新颖的混合规划器，它在生成与精化两个阶段采用统一的目标集合。我们的模型促使所有组件遵循相同的共享驾驶目标：避碰、可行驶区域合规、舒适性以及前进进度。DiffuSearch 采用两阶段架构：首先，一个引导式扩散模型生成场景一致的联合轨迹预测，将驾驶目标作为可微分引导函数，隐式地引导去噪过程；其次，在离散化动作空间中进行蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），对轨迹进行显式的局部精化。
tldr: DiffuSearch 提出了一种混合轨迹规划器，通过在扩散生成与 MCTS 精化两个阶段统一使用相同的驾驶目标（避碰、可行驶区域合规、舒适性和前进进度），解决了传统混合规划架构中初始轨迹与精化轨迹不一致的问题。
en_tdlr: DiffuSearch proposes a hybrid trajectory planner that aligns a unified set of driving objectives (collision avoidance, drivable area compliance, comfort, and progress) across both diffusion-based trajectory generation and MCTS-based refinement, resolving the inconsistency between initial and refined trajectories in hybrid planning architectures.
